tools.name: st_list_customers
tools.description: List ServiceTitan customers with optional pagination and modified-after filter. Read-only. Cached 5 min. Calls taylor-ai /api/st/read which handles ST OAuth.

modifiedOnOrAfter.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, returns customers modified on or after this time

tools.name: st_get_customer
tools.description: Get a single ServiceTitan customer by ID. Read-only. Cached 5 min.

tools.name: st_list_jobs
tools.description: List ServiceTitan jobs. Read-only. NOT cached (jobs change frequently). Note: the Jobs API does NOT include the scheduled date — use st_list_appointments with start filter instead.

jobStatus.description: ST job status filter (Scheduled, InProgress, Hold, Completed, Canceled, etc.)

tools.name: st_list_appointments
tools.description: List ServiceTitan appointments. Read-only. NOT cached. Use this for scheduled-date queries — the ST Jobs API does NOT have a scheduled date field, Appointments does (start).

tools.name: st_get_pricebook
tools.description: List ServiceTitan pricebook items by asset type (services, materials, or equipment). Read-only. Cached 10 min. The primary source for pricebook data is the pb_services / pb_materials / pb_equipment D1 tables synced nightly — use this tool for live-state verification.

tools.name: st_patch_service
tools.description: PATCH a ServiceTitan pricebook service by ID. dryRun=true (default) validates and returns a confirmation_token — call again with dryRun=false + token to write. QSC uses dynamic pricing (useStaticPrice=false) — do NOT set price unless fixing a static-price item.

cost.description: Internal cost (required for correct job costing)

price.description: Static price. Only meaningful when useStaticPrice=true.

useStaticPrice.description: true = static price; false = dynamic markup (QSC default)

active.description: Whether the service is active in the pricebook

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

confirmation_token.description: Token from prior dryRun=true call, required when dryRun=false

tools.name: st_create_service
tools.description: Create a new ServiceTitan pricebook service. dryRun=true (default) validates and returns a confirmation_token — call again with dryRun=false + token to write. QSC uses dynamic pricing (useStaticPrice=false) — do NOT set price unless this is a static-price service.

price.description: Static price. Only set when useStaticPrice=true.

useStaticPrice.description: true = static price; false = dynamic markup (QSC default)

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

confirmation_token.description: Token from prior dryRun=true call, required when dryRun=false

tools.name: st_patch_material
tools.description: PATCH a ServiceTitan pricebook material by ID. dryRun=true (default) validates and returns a confirmation_token — call again with dryRun=false + token to write. Send only the fields you want to change.

price.description: Price per unit charged to the customer

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

confirmation_token.description: Token from prior dryRun=true call, required when dryRun=false

tools.name: st_create_material
tools.description: Create a new ServiceTitan pricebook material. dryRun=true (default) validates and returns a confirmation_token — call again with dryRun=false + token to write. Requires name and categoryId at minimum.

price.description: Price per unit charged to the customer

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

confirmation_token.description: Token from prior dryRun=true call, required when dryRun=false

tools.name: find_customer
tools.description: Search ST customers by name, phone, or email. Source: live ST.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Get a single ST customer by ID. Source: live ST.

tools.name: get_customer_locations
tools.description: Get service locations for a customer. Source: live ST.

tools.name: list_customer_jobs
tools.description: List jobs for a customer. Source: live ST (auto-falls-back to live if D1 stale >48h).

tools.name: get_customer_membership
tools.description: Get memberships for a customer. Source: live ST (no D1 memberships table).

tools.name: add_customer_note
tools.description: Append a note to a customer record. ST notes are append-only — this creates a new note entry, not an update. dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get a single ST job by ID. Source: live ST.

tools.name: list_jobs_today
tools.description: List ST jobs scheduled for today. Source: live ST.

tools.name: get_job_appointments
tools.description: Get appointments for a job. Source: live ST.

tools.name: add_job_note
tools.description: Append a note to a job. ST notes are append-only. dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: book_job
tools.description: Book a new ST job. campaignId is required — ST rejects jobs without it. dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

campaignId.description: ST campaign ID — REQUIRED by ST API

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Reschedule an appointment (PATCH start/end/arrivalWindow). Tech assignments stay pinned to the old slot — use assign_technicians separately if you need them to follow. dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: hold_appointment
tools.description: Place an appointment on hold via the ST /hold sub-route (POST, not PATCH). dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

memo.description: Optional memo text for the hold

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: assign_technicians
tools.description: Assign technicians to an appointment. ST requires a two-call compound: unassign all current techs, then assign the new set. Both calls are shown in the dryRun preview. dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

technicianIds.description: Technician IDs to assign (replaces current assignment)

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: search_pricebook_services
tools.description: Search pricebook services by name or category. Source: D1 (pb_services fresh 2026-04-22; auto-falls-back to live ST if stale >48h).

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Get full details for a single pricebook service including pricing tiers and categories. Source: D1 (pb_services fresh 2026-04-22).

tools.name: search_materials
tools.description: Search pricebook materials by name or category. Source: live ST (pb_materials 23d stale in D1 — falls back to live until sync fixed).

tools.name: get_configurable_equipment_children
tools.description: Get child equipment variations for a configurable (parent) equipment item. ST vocabulary: isConfigurableEquipment=true on the parent. Source: live ST (pb_equipment 37d stale in D1).

parentEquipmentId.description: ST pricebook equipment ID of the parent (isConfigurableEquipment=true)

tools.name: list_service_categories
tools.description: List pricebook service categories (not materials/equipment categories — those are separate trees). Source: live ST.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get full invoice details including line items and totals. Source: D1 (invoices nightly-synced).

tools.name: list_invoices_job
tools.description: List all invoices for a specific job. Source: D1 (invoices nightly-synced).

tools.name: get_invoice_balance
tools.description: Get the outstanding balance for an invoice. Returns balance, total, and payment summary from the invoice record. Source: D1 (invoices nightly-synced). Note: renamed from get_payment_status — /payments/{id} returns a payment object; balance lives on the invoice.

tools.name: list_unpaid_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with an outstanding balance (unpaid or partially paid). Source: D1 (invoices nightly-synced).

tools.name: list_estimates_job
tools.description: List all estimates for a specific job. Source: D1 (estimates nightly-synced).

tools.name: get_estimate
tools.description: Get full details for a single estimate including line items and status. Source: D1 (estimates nightly-synced).

tools.name: update_estimate_status
tools.description: Update the status of an estimate (Open → Presented → Sold|Dismissed|Expired). status=Sold requires soldBy technicianId (ST rejects without it). dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: get_capacity
tools.description: Get dispatch capacity for business units over a date range. Note: this is a POST call to ST (not GET — the body carries the filter params). Source: live ST (computed endpoint).

businessUnitIds.description: Business unit IDs to check capacity for

tools.name: list_technicians_available
tools.description: List technicians available for dispatch on a given date. Source: D1 (technicians nightly-synced).

date.description: Date to check availability (YYYY-MM-DD, default: today)

tools.name: get_technician_shifts
tools.description: Get scheduled shifts for a technician. Source: live ST (shifts are computed, not in D1).

startsOnOrAfter.description: Filter shifts starting on or after this date (ISO 8601)

startsBefore.description: Filter shifts starting before this date (ISO 8601)

tools.name: list_non_job_events
tools.description: List non-job dispatch events (time-off, training, meetings) for technicians. Source: live ST.

startsOnOrAfter.description: Filter events starting on or after this date (ISO 8601)

startsBefore.description: Filter events starting before this date (ISO 8601)

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List marketing campaigns. Source: D1 (campaigns nightly-synced).

tools.name: get_campaign_performance
tools.description: Get performance metrics for a campaign (leads, bookings, revenue) via ST Reporting API. Source: live ST (Reporting API — not in D1).

tools.name: create_call_with_campaign
tools.description: Create a telecom call record attributed to a marketing campaign. Note: ST has no "lead attribution" object — this POSTs to /telecom/v3/tenant/.../calls with campaignId stitched in. dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

campaignId.description: ST campaign ID to attribute the call to

leadCallId.description: External call ID from your call tracking system (e.g. Lace)

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: list_memberships_active
tools.description: List active memberships. Source: live ST (no D1 table for memberships — all membership tools hit live ST). Response is trimmed to essential fields; client-side filtered to status=Active since ST statuses param filters on the meaningless active-bool, not the status enum.

pageSize.description: Page size, max 100 (capped to keep response under MCP token limit)

tools.name: list_memberships_expiring
tools.description: List active memberships expiring within the next N days. Uses expirationDate range filter (NOT renewedById — unreliable). Response is trimmed to essential fields; client-side filtered to status=Active. Source: live ST (no D1 memberships table).

windowDays.description: Number of days ahead to look for expiring memberships (e.g. 30 = expiring within 30 days)

pageSize.description: Page size, max 100 (capped to keep response under MCP token limit)

tools.name: create_recurring_service
tools.description: Create a recurring service under an active membership. ST requires the membership to be Active (returns 400 otherwise). dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

membershipId.description: ST membership ID (must be Active status)

serviceTypeId.description: ST service type ID for the recurring service

locationId.description: ST location ID where the service will be performed

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get details for a telecom call record including duration, campaign attribution, and recording info. Source: D1 (calls nightly-synced).

tools.name: get_form_submission
tools.description: Get a form submission record. Note: form submissions return unit IDs, not equipment IDs — equipment join is done in the job_closeout_report composite via the forms_equipment D1 table. Source: live ST.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task linked to a job. Path: /taskmanagement/ (no hyphen — ST 404s on /task-management/). dryRun=true (default) → token → dryRun=false to write.

jobId.description: ST job ID to link the task to

assignedToId.description: Employee ID to assign the task to

dryRun.description: true (default) = preview + token; false = execute write

tools.name: list_open_tasks
tools.description: List open (incomplete) tasks. Path: /taskmanagement/ (no hyphen — ST 404s on /task-management/). Source: live ST.

tools.name: customer_snapshot
tools.description: L5 composite: returns a full customer snapshot — customer details, locations, jobs, memberships, estimates, and invoices in a single call. Uses single-flight DO to prevent thundering-herd. ~5 min cache via mv_customer_snapshot. Source: mixed (D1 + live ST for memberships).

tools.name: pricebook_health_check_services
tools.description: L5 composite: pricebook health check for SERVICES only. Checks for zero-cost services, missing categories, and inactive items. pb_services is fresh (synced 2026-04-22). Materials + equipment blocked until nightly sync fix (§13#1). Source: D1 (pb_services).

tools.name: job_closeout_report
tools.description: L5 composite: full job closeout report — job details, appointments, technicians, invoice, and form submissions. Note: form submissions use unit IDs (not equipment IDs); equipment join done via forms_equipment D1 table. Source: mixed (D1 + live ST).

tools.name: margin_audit
tools.description: L5 composite: margin audit for a business unit over a date range. Joins jobs + invoice items + cost fields. 60 min memo (mv_margin_audit). Source: D1 (jobs/invoices nightly-synced).

tools.name: membership_outreach_list
tools.description: L5 composite: outreach contact list for a membership segment. Segments: expiring_30/60/90 (expiring within N days), lapsed (status=Cancelled last 90d). 30 min memo. Source: live ST (no D1 memberships table).

tools.name: dispatch_override_audit
tools.description: L5 composite: audit of dispatch assignment overrides (technician reassignments) in a date range. Joins appointment_assignments + appointments + technicians. 60 min memo. Source: D1 (appointment_assignments nightly-synced).

tools.name: call_quality_review
tools.description: L5 composite: call quality review combining ST call records with available transcripts. 15 min memo. Source: D1 (calls + call_transcripts nightly-synced). Note: Lace score integration deferred to v1.1.

csr.description: Filter by CSR name or employee ID

tools.name: commercial_plumbing_opportunities
tools.description: L5 composite: commercial plumbing upsell opportunities — customers with commercial plumbing history who haven't booked in 90+ days. 60 min memo. Source: D1 (jobs + tags nightly-synced).

lookbackDays.description: Days without booking to consider an opportunity (default: 90)

tools.name: membership_jackpot_leaderboard
tools.description: L5 composite: membership sales leaderboard for the Jackpot Drive. Employee names anonymized until 2026-07-04 per Jackpot Drive rules — only rank and count are shown before that date. 30 min memo. Source: D1 (memberships nightly-synced).

limit.description: Number of top performers to return (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: siro_list_mobile_events
tools.description: List Siro mobile events (recording/sync/activity events). Read-only. Cached 2 min. Siro is the in-person sales coaching recorder acquired by ServiceTitan.

pageSize.description: Max events per page (default 50, max 100 per Siro docs)

after.description: ISO timestamp — return events after this time

before.description: ISO timestamp — return events before this time

userId.description: Filter to a specific Siro user

tools.name: siro_get_recording_summary
tools.description: Get the AI-generated summary for a Siro recording (sales conversation analysis, key moments, coaching points). Read-only. Cached 1 hour.

tools.name: siro_get_engagement
tools.description: Get a Siro engagement (linked recording data — typically a single visit/interaction with a customer). Read-only. Cached 10 min.
